MIRA Bridge™ is the official application for the MIRA ID Jewelry Management and Smart Security Gate System.

Supports:
• UHF RFID Scanning
• QR/GS1 DataMatrix Camera
• Radar Positioning
• MIRA Secure Gate™
• Integration with MIRA ID Cloud
